game_events.rederivation_notes: My chain before reading the record: KXNHLOT = P(score level at 60:00) (OT faceoff taken). Stages: (1) team goal means from shot volume x quality x opposing goalie plus PP; (2) bivariate overdispersed count whose diagonal is the tie mass, falling with expected total and peaking at zero gap; (3) starter/lineup mixture; (4) late 6v5 / empty-net process that moves diagonal mass; (5) season-type regime (regular 3v3+SO vs playoff 20-min 5v5, so 2OT and series-OT exist only in playoffs); (6) postponement 48h rule. Required inputs: xG pair, goalie, tie model, empty-net/pull policy, playoff flag, rules text. The record matched all of this and additionally dropped first_goal_hazard/opening_shift/shootout as irrelevant, which I agree with. Differences: record spends 3 of 4 new inputs on playoff-only siblings that are dormant in November; no league-level tie-rate drift input.

findings.text: nhl.ot_sudden_death_hazard_5v5 and nhl.series_ot_count_dependence serve only KXNHL2OT/KXNHLSERIESOT (TITLE_ONLY, no markets, playoffs only); they are dormant for KXNHLOT in the regular season and should be labelled playoff-only/dormant rather than required.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: relabelled nhl.ot_sudden_death_hazard_5v5 and nhl.series_ot_count_dependence in game_events.new_inputs as playoff-only/dormant and demoted both to role context; KXNHL2OT/KXNHLSERIESOT have no markets (TITLE_ONLY).

findings.text: nhl.game_script_prob is audited WEAK ('win probability is the wrong summary') yet appears in the regime-switch interaction ['nhl.third_period_equalizer_hazard','nhl.empty_net','nhl.game_script_prob'] and in game_context_script coverage; inconsistent.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: nhl.game_script_prob audit changed to BENCHMARK_ONLY (market-line contamination) and replaced by the market-free new input nhl.ratings_script_distribution in stage s3, game_context_script coverage, interaction 1 and required_data[1].

findings.text: nhl.reg_tie_model is KEEP_PRIMARY but is a model output (tie probability), not a raw input; the raw drivers are the xG pair/dispersion. Also no input for season-to-season drift of the league regulation tie rate (the 0.22-0.27 base is asserted without source).
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: nhl.reg_tie_model audit reason rewritten to state it is a model output with xG pair/dispersion as raw drivers; league tie-rate drift added as unresolved ge5 (INPUT_DEFINITION_UNCERTAIN, distribution_variance) since no sourced season table exists.

findings.text: Source claim that situationCode identifies goalie-in-net is disclosed as SOURCE_UNVERIFIED (ge4); not verified by me either.
findings.resolution: DEFERRED_TO_UNRESOLVED:ge4

game_moneyline_puckline.rederivation_notes: Own chain before reading the record: ML = P(win incl OT/SO) = regulation win prob + tie prob x ~0.5; spread 'wins by over x.5' = tail of final margin. Stages: team strength (xG share, goalie, special teams) with early-season prior blend; goalie/lineup confirmation shocks; home ice; score effects and empty-net goals fattening margin tails; regulation-tie/OT/SO resolution; shootout counted as +1 margin (rules for totals say SO is one goal; spread text silent). Settlement hazards: no push, 48h postponement fair price, OT/SO not mentioned in KXNHLGAME text. Series KXNHLPRES/KXNHLMVP/KXNHLSERIES are not game contracts. The record covered all of this including the SO-margin ambiguity and the mis-mapping; differences are minor.

findings.text: Mis-mapping is disclosed (ml2) but not resolved: KXNHLPRES (season futures), KXNHLMVP/Hart (KXNHLHART already sits in season_futures) and KXNHLSERIES (best-of-7 series model: series length, game-level win probs, home pattern) have no mechanism or inputs anywhere in this record, so three live series of this archetype key have zero input coverage until re-mapped.
findings.resolution: DEFERRED_TO_UNRESOLVED:ml5

findings.text: ml1 says the SO +1 credit is only an assumption, but KXNHLTOTAL/KXNHLTEAMTOTAL rules text (same league, same scoring convention) explicitly records the shootout winner as one extra goal; cite that as corroborating (not conclusive for KXNHLSPREAD) evidence. Winner contract OT/SO inclusion remains an inference from silence.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: variants_and_edge_cases[0] and unresolved ml1 now cite the KXNHLTOTAL/KXNHLTEAMTOTAL rules text recording the shootout winner as one goal, marked corroborating but not conclusive for KXNHLSPREAD.

findings.text: nhl.lineup_impact_delta is primary with free source 'HockeyViz impact (visual)'; HockeyViz is not a data feed, so the free path is effectively RAPM via own computation from shift charts; label SOURCE_UNVERIFIED for free access.
findings.resolution: DEFERRED_TO_UNRESOLVED:ml6

findings.text: pace_volume marked NOT_APPLICABLE although total/pace sets margin variance and therefore the 1.5/2.5 rung tails; the record itself uses total_goal_dispersion for that. Interaction ['nhl.reg_tie_model','nhl.ot_so','nhl.settlement_goal_pmf'] is an accounting identity (reg win + tie*0.5), not an interaction; ['nhl.lineup_impact_delta','nhl.injuries_pit','nhl.standings_stakes'] is irrelevant in November.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: pace_volume changed from NOT_APPLICABLE to COVERED via total_goal_dispersion; interaction 2 (accounting identity) replaced by total x gap joint-distribution; interaction 5 restated as dormant in November and limited to games 72-82.

findings.text: Empty-net conversion '40-60 percent' of one-goal leads past 3:00 is an unsourced number.
findings.resolution: DEFERRED_TO_UNRESOLVED:ml7

game_total_and_team_total.rederivation_notes: Own chain: total = sum of two overdispersed goal counts (attempt volume pair x xG quality x goalie) + PP goals (penalty counts, PP termination) + empty-net goals; settlement transform: OT goals count, SO adds exactly one goal to winner (total 2k+1, team total k+1), no SO in playoffs; ladder rungs 9.5-11.5 and team 5.5 are tail events set by dispersion/meltdown mixture. Inputs: pair pace, xG, goalie start/quality, penalty rates+crew, special teams, empty-net, dispersion, rules text, season type. The record matches, adds pair_attempt_volume, PP termination, settlement pmf. Differences: it marks officials as duplicate of penalty_rates yet keeps it in coverage/feeds; coaching tempo declared GAP (honest); series total has no model of series length.

findings.text: nhl.officials is audited DUPLICATE_OF nhl.penalty_rates but still listed in officiating_rules coverage and in required_data feeds_inputs; the catalog penalty_rates label does include crew tendencies, but crew assignment is only partially pregame-known (posted day-of), so vintage handling should stay explicit.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: removed nhl.officials from officiating_rules coverage and required_data[1] feeds (audited DUPLICATE_OF nhl.penalty_rates) and added an explicit game-day vintage rule: crew term used only after posting, zero before.

findings.text: Interaction ['nhl.empty_net','nhl.score_state','nhl.venue'] is not an interaction: the mechanism text itself says rink effects are negligible; venue does not belong in it.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: interaction 4 re-specified as empty_net x score_state x goalie_pull_risk (threshold on entering lead and pull policy); venue removed because the mechanism itself says rink effects are negligible.

findings.text: KXNHLSERIESTOTALGOAL is in the archetype but needs a series-length distribution (games played) as an input; not listed (only disclosed as CONTRACT_AMBIGUOUS tt2).
findings.resolution: DEFERRED_TO_UNRESOLVED:tt5

findings.text: KXNHLTOTAL live_series is TITLE_ONLY in the evidence pack while a rules sample exists (finalized market); settlement quotes are valid but strike coverage and playoff behavior are unseen; 'about a tenth of games go to a shootout' is unsourced.
findings.resolution: DEFERRED_TO_UNRESOLVED:tt6

goalie_saves.rederivation_notes: Own chain: saves = shots on goal faced while in net minus goals allowed. Stages: (1) exposure: start/no-start (active-never-enters settles at last fair price, so condition on entering), pull after goal burst, relief appearance; (2) opponent SOG flow: opponent SOG-for by strength state x defence SOG-against, PP minutes, score effects (leaders get outshot, so the LEADING team's goalie faces extra shots, including 6v5 late; the trailing team's goalie is on the bench late); (3) binomial thinning at ~0.90; (4) counting: OT 3v3 saves, shootout shots excluded from official saves, arena SOG recording. Required: goalie start/forecast, minutes-in-net distribution, opponent SOG rate, shots_against, goalie quality, score-state expectation, penalty/PP rates, stat_dist, rules. The record largely matches; the key difference is that it states the score-effect direction backwards.

findings.text: Mechanism error on score effects. Summary: 'a goalie on a trailing team faces 6v5 shots late' is backwards: the trailing team pulls its goalie, so the LEADER's goalie faces the 6v5 shots and the trailing goalie is out of net. Interaction 5 (game_script_prob, score_state, shots_against): 'goalie of a heavy favourite faces fewer shots because leads shift play to the offensive zone' also inverts the score effect (catalog nhl.score_state/shots_against state leading teams concede more shots). Direction of the favourite/underdog shots-faced effect must be re-derived; as written it would mis-sign game_script_prob for this market.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: corrected summary and stage s2 (leading team's goalie faces the 6v5 shots; trailing goalie is out of net) and rewrote interaction 4 with explicit opposing signs of team shot suppression and lead-driven shots; game_script_prob replaced by market-free nhl.ratings_script_distribution.

findings.text: Interaction 3 uses m.quote_history as an interaction input; a market price path is a benchmark, not an input (the record itself marks it BENCHMARK_ONLY elsewhere). Remove or reword as a validation contrast.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: interaction 2 no longer uses m.quote_history; it is now goalie_start_forecast x shots_against x goalie_quality with Kalshi price paths named only as an external validation contrast.

findings.text: nhl.game_script_prob kept KEEP_SECONDARY, but its catalog measurement derives it 'from team ratings (and the market line)'; market-line contamination is not noted. Also nhl.venue (SOG recording bias) and new nhl.arena_sog_recording_factor measure the same thing; venue should be reduced to home-ice only or marked duplicate.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: nhl.game_script_prob audited BENCHMARK_ONLY (market-line contamination) and replaced by nhl.ratings_script_distribution; nhl.venue audited DUPLICATE_OF nhl.arena_sog_recording_factor and removed from stage s4, coverage and data feeds.

findings.text: arena_sog_recording_factor rule 'use only when posterior mean exceeds 1.5 sd' is a selection rule that biases estimates (winner's curse); use the shrunk estimate throughout. Existence of an arena bias after tracking is disclosed uncertain (gs4).
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: arena_sog_recording_factor measurement rewritten to use the shrunk posterior mean for all arenas with no 1.5-sd selection rule (in both goalie_saves and player_shots_on_goal records).

findings.text: Settlement wording 'last traded fair price' in rules_evidence 'establishes' is an inference; text says 'last fair market price before game start'. Whether OT saves and not-dressed goalies count remains CONTRACT_AMBIGUOUS (disclosed gs1). League average 'about 30 shots per game' is high versus roughly 27-28 recent seasons (unverified).
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: rules_evidence establishes text now quotes "last fair market price before game start" without inferring a traded price; league average shots softened to roughly 27-30 per team-game, to be measured, in stage s2 and summary. OT/not-dressed ambiguity remains in gs1.

findings.text: Pull exposure: the pull hazard needs coach-specific and goalie-quality terms but the coaching_scheme gap is only declared, and the data claim that NHL boxscore exposes goalie relief-entry time is SOURCE_UNVERIFIED (gs3); entry time may need play-by-play.
findings.resolution: DEFERRED_TO_UNRESOLVED:gs3

offfield_markets.rederivation_notes: Own chain before reading: three unrelated processes. (a) KXNHLNEXTTEAM: partition over 32 teams + retire/no team; driven by contract status (expiry, NMC/NTC), trade/free-agency calendar, team cap and need, player intent, rumor flow; default status quo; resolves only on actual signing/trade. (b) KXNHLEXPANSION: gated by Board of Governors approval, only on official announcement naming the city; very rare base rate. (c) KXNHLLINDSAY: player-voted award, multinomial over finalists, 1/N tie payout; it is really an awards contract. Settlement hazards: official announcement requirement, stale/expired windows, tie payout. Required: status/clauses, suitor fit, governance gates, calendar, news credibility, award voting model. Record matches on (a),(b); differs in treating Lindsay as a legitimate off-field member and not narrowing base rates.

findings.text: Undisclosed mis-mapping: KXNHLLINDSAY (Ted Lindsay Award) is a season award, which the ledger also covers under season_awards_and_stats/season_futures (KXNHLHART, KXNHLADAMS there). The record builds stage s4 and 4 inputs/data rows for it as if native, while the ml record flags equivalent mis-mapping; this is not disclosed here, risking duplicate or inconsistent award inputs across archetypes.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: added series_mapping_issues (KXNHLLINDSAY belongs in season_awards_and_stats) and stated in settlement_definition that stage s4 is a provisional copy of the awards chain; award inputs (award_stats, award_voting_rules) replaced by player_season_points_projection and the shared vote model.

findings.text: nhl.award_vote_share_model requires 'last 20 seasons' finalists and vote shares' from Hockey-Reference/NHL awards archive. Ted Lindsay results are NHLPA-voted and, as far as I know, full vote shares are not published (finalists and winner only); the record itself admits electorate/ballot facts are from memory (of3). Unverified source claim: SOURCE_UNVERIFIED; the required data may not exist, so the measurement cannot be relied on.
findings.resolution: DEFERRED_TO_UNRESOLVED:of5

findings.text: nhl.offfield_base_rate is audited WEAK ('pooled base rate is meaningless; each class needs a narrow reference class') but no replacement input is defined: no per-class base-rate/hazard input (player move within window by contract status; expansion per year; award by finalist). It still anchors stage s1, coverage distribution_variance and interaction 1, so the central quantity for rare-event markets has no valid definition.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: defined new input nhl.reference_class_hazard (per-class estimators for player moves, expansion and awards) and replaced the audited-WEAK nhl.offfield_base_rate in stage s1, coverage, interaction 0 and data feeds.

findings.text: KXNHLNEXTTEAM sample is a finalized market with a lapsed window (Nov 1, 2026) and the rules sample shows rules for multi-outcome partitions incl. 'Retires / No Team'; missing input for trade-specific mechanics (trade demand/player intent, team seller status, trade-deadline timing) beyond contract clauses.
findings.resolution: DEFERRED_TO_UNRESOLVED:of6

findings.text: Interactions 1 and 5 combine inputs not real contrasts (award_stats/award_voting_rules referenced from the awards inputs, none defined here); m.lifecycle KEEP_SECONDARY is a settlement/window parameter, not a driver. Source 'Archive services unavailable_public' for insider reports is honest.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: interactions 4 no longer cites award_stats/award_voting_rules (uses the defined player_season_points_projection and vote model); m.lifecycle audit reworded as a window/settlement parameter, not a driver.

parlay_combo.rederivation_notes: Own chain: combo pays only if all legs hit, price = joint probability. No live NHL combo series and no rules text, so everything is structural. Mechanism: shared latent game drivers (goal intensity, goalie states/pulls, PP count, script) generate team goals; player legs are allocations of team goals; logical relations (nested ladders, win vs opponent win, team total vs game total) fix part of joint exactly; lineup scenarios correlate legs; void-leg payoff map defines contract. Cross-game legs would be near independent apart from shared news; same-game legs need a joint simulator. Required: leg rules per leg, void map, joint simulator inputs, credit allocation, lineup scenario tree. The record covers this thoroughly and discloses NO_LIVE_SERIES; differences are in leg-structure assumption and a market-contaminated input.

findings.text: nhl.game_script_prob is KEEP_PRIMARY (the shared factor), but the catalog measurement derives it 'from team ratings (and the market line)'; a market-derived value is used as the central input without flagging it. The same input is WEAK in game_events/period_markets. Require a ratings-only definition or mark it BENCHMARK-contaminated.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: nhl.game_script_prob audited BENCHMARK_ONLY (catalog measurement uses the market line) and replaced as the shared latent by the market-free nhl.ratings_script_distribution (primary) in stage s2, coverage, interactions 0 and 5, nonlinearity 1 and data feeds.

findings.text: The mechanism, copula and credit-allocation machinery assume same-game multi-leg combos, but no series exists to show that. Kalshi's actual combo products may be cross-game/cross-sport collections of existing markets, where the needed inputs are leg marginals and void/settlement rules, not within-game dependence. The record lists this as CONTRACT_AMBIGUOUS (pc1) but then makes dependence inputs (copula_tail_dependence, credit kernel) primary; whether they are required is unverified (SOURCE_UNVERIFIED).
findings.resolution: DEFERRED_TO_UNRESOLVED:pc5

findings.text: new input nhl.copula_tail_dependence is not referenced in any stage input_ids; copula fitting on discrete margins with ties is weakly identified. 'Star minutes fall only at margins above two goals' threshold and chi(u) levels are asserted without data.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: nhl.copula_tail_dependence added to stage s2 and demoted to context; credit kernel demoted to secondary; the threshold in the star-minutes nonlinearity is restated as a hypothesis with the threshold to be estimated.

findings.text: Interaction 1 labelled 'convex' is simple positive dependence; interaction 2 (goalie_start, injuries_pit) asserts a back-to-back link between backup start and star absence that is not evidenced. xg_for/xg_against KEEP_CONTEXT but listed as talent_strength coverage for a combo; acceptable.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: interaction 0 relabelled joint-distribution (it is positive dependence, not convexity); interaction 1 backup-goalie/star-absence link restated as an unevidenced hypothesis with a test that drops it if the odds ratio is not distinguishable from one.

period_markets.rederivation_notes: Own chain before reading: a period is a 20-min slice with team goal mean ~1.0 each (total ~2.0), so 0-0 and 1-1 dominate; Poisson(1,1) gives tie ~31% and 0-0 ~13.5%. Stages: team period rates (period factor, 2nd-period long change), home last change in P1/P3, goalie, entering score state for P2/P3, PP lumpiness and penalty counts, 3rd-period empty-net (OT excluded by rules text), bivariate count with cross-period dependence. Settlement: 'period tie' contract pays YES when neither team wins; spread rungs 1.5/2.5; third-period excludes OT; templated 3P note appears on 1P/2P rules. Required inputs: period-specific rates, home flag, goalie, entering state, penalty/PP, rest/fatigue, rules. Differences: record omits home-ice/rest from period markets entirely.

findings.text: No home-ice/venue input anywhere in period_markets (no nhl.venue in stages, coverage or audit). environment is declared NOT_APPLICABLE ('rink scoring factors act the same across periods... nothing period-specific'), but winner/spread contracts are team-vs-team, home advantage is a modest constant, and the home team has last change in periods 1 and 3 (the record itself models long change in P2 only). The home flag/last-change effect is a required input that is missing.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: added new input nhl.period_home_ice_split (home flag and period-specific home edge, league-level last change) to stage s1, talent_strength coverage and data feeds; environment changed from NOT_APPLICABLE to COVERED. Note the home team has last change in all periods, not only 1 and 3.

findings.text: situational_schedule_motivation declared NOT_APPLICABLE ('no mechanism makes them differ between periods'). Back-to-back/travel fatigue is plausibly period-specific (late-game fade), and rest drives backup-goalie probability which changes the period-1 goalie; rest_travel is a catalog input not even considered. The NA reason overreaches and the gap is not disclosed in unresolved.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: situational_schedule_motivation changed to COVERED via new input nhl.rest_fatigue_period_profile (period-specific rest effect with backup-goalie channel separated), added to stage s2 and data feeds; the unproven fatigue-fade channel is disclosed as unresolved pm6.

findings.text: Numeric claim 'P(tie) about 35-40 percent' per period conflicts with the Poisson(1,1) benchmark (~31%) and typical NHL period tie rates in low 30s with overdispersion; P(0-0) 12-16% is fine. Unsourced.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: stage s5 distribution text corrected to P(tie) in the low-to-mid 30s percent with the Poisson(1,1) benchmark of about 31 percent noted; both flagged as unsourced and to be measured.

findings.text: Inputs audited WEAK remain in use: game_script_prob and total_goal_dispersion are listed in stage input_ids (s3, s5) and coverage despite 'replace by' verdicts; opening_shift_deployment (WEAK) drives interaction 5 and stage s2 though the record says its information is negligible. Interaction 3 (long_change_effect x coach_deployment_style x period_split) is speculative, no named contrast.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: WEAK inputs removed from use: total_goal_dispersion out of s5, coverage and data feeds; opening_shift_deployment out of s2, coverage, feeds and interaction 4; game_script_prob replaced by market-free nhl.ratings_script_distribution; interaction 2 reframed as an explicit hypothesis with a named contrast.

findings.text: s5 says 'independence of period markets from the final result must be encoded', which is wrong (periods compose the final score; cross-period dependence is itself modelled). KXNHL1PBTTS, KXNHL2PSPREAD, KXNHL1PTOTAL are TITLE_ONLY/partially sampled; claim 'Hockey-Reference period scoring tables' and NHL API first-shift lines are SOURCE_UNVERIFIED (pm3).
findings.resolution: DEFERRED_TO_UNRESOLVED:pm7
